marketing.segCarFeaturesTitle: What a car rental needs, in one place
marketing.segCarF1Body: Turn on your booking page or send a booking link. Customers photograph their passport and driver's license and sign the agreement on their phone before pickup.
marketing.segCarF2Title: Handover with photos, fuel and mileage
marketing.segCarF2Body: Read the odometer from a photo, record fuel and damage, and get the customer's signature. At return, RoveHQ shows what changed since handover.
marketing.segCarF3Body: Take a deposit, deduct fuel or damage at return and give back the rest, all on record. Customers pay by bank transfer, Wise, Revolut or QR code and send the receipt, and RoveHQ matches it to the booking.
marketing.segCarF4Body: Set monthly prices, offer a lower price for paying months ahead and raise prices for high season. Extend a rental and the customer signs the change on their phone.

marketing.segCarQ1: Is RoveHQ free for a small car rental business?
marketing.segCarA1: Yes. The Free plan covers up to {freeCars} cars and {free} motorbikes. Bigger fleets pay by fleet size, and every business starts with 30 days of everything.
marketing.segCarQ2: Can customers book my cars online?
marketing.segCarA2: Yes. Turn on your booking page and customers can book your free cars at your prices without you approving each one. You can also send a booking link for a booking you make.
marketing.segCarQ3: Can I use my own rental agreement?
marketing.segCarA3: Yes. Upload the contract you already use and customers sign it on their phone, or use the RoveHQ agreement.
marketing.segCarQ4: Do I need to install anything?

marketing.segScooterIntro: Scooter rentals are short, frequent and often handed over at the door. Customers book and sign on their phone, you check each scooter out and back in with photos, and payments are matched to the right booking.
marketing.segScooterFeaturesTitle: Made for a busy scooter shop
marketing.segScooterF1Body: One link for the dates, passport and license photos, and the signature. Details are read from the photos, so nobody types them in.
marketing.segScooterF2Body: A walkaround video or four photos, plus fuel and kilometers, at handover. At return, compare side by side and settle any damage with proof.
marketing.segScooterF3Body: See which deposits you hold, take deductions at return and give back the rest. A deposit stays a deposit, not income.
marketing.segScooterF4Body: Add extras charged per day or once per booking, for bikes only if you like. They show on your booking page and go on the agreement.
marketing.segScooterF5Body: The calendar shows which scooters are out, booked or free, with today's handovers and returns.
marketing.segScooterF6Body: Scooters are counted separately from cars, so a scooter shop fits a small plan: Free covers up to {free} motorbikes, Starter {starter} and Pro {pro}.
marketing.segScooterQ1: How are scooters counted on the plans?
marketing.segScooterA1: Separately from cars. Motorbikes, scooters, e-bikes and ATVs count as motorbikes, so a shop with many scooters and no cars still fits a small plan.
marketing.segScooterQ2: Can I charge for helmets and other extras?
marketing.segScooterA2: Yes. Add paid extras per day or once per booking. They appear on the booking form and your booking page, are added to the first payment and go on the agreement.
marketing.segScooterQ3: What if a scooter comes back damaged?
marketing.segScooterA3: Compare the return photos with the handover photos, record the new damage and take the cost from the deposit. Anything over the deposit goes on the customer's booking.
marketing.segScooterQ4: Do my customers need an app?

marketing.segMotoIntro: Whether you rent big bikes for touring or small ones by the week, RoveHQ handles the paperwork from your phone: bookings with license photos, signed agreements, handover checks, deposits and service reminders.
marketing.segMotoF1Title: License and passport from a photo
marketing.segMotoF1Body: Customers photograph their documents when they book. RoveHQ reads the details and keeps them with the booking.
marketing.segMotoF2Body: Set where bikes may go (other countries, islands by ferry), kilometer limits and late fees once. They go into every agreement.
marketing.segMotoF3Body: Photos, odometer, fuel and damage at handover and return, signed by the customer. Disputes are settled with photos, not memory.
marketing.segMotoF4Body: Log services, oil changes, tires and repairs. RoveHQ shows when the next one is due, and a bike in the shop can't be booked.
marketing.segMotoF5Body: Take a deposit, deduct for damage at return and give back the rest. Choose how customers can pay you and see who still owes.
marketing.segMotoF6Body: Fully booked? Pass the customer to a partner business and earn a finder's fee.
marketing.segMotoQ1: Are motorcycles counted like cars on the plans?
marketing.segMotoA1: No. Motorcycles count with scooters and other two-wheelers, separately from cars, so a bike fleet fits a smaller plan.
marketing.segMotoQ2: Can I stop customers taking a bike across a border or on a ferry?
marketing.segMotoA2: Yes. Set it as not allowed, ask customers to tell you first, or charge an extra deposit. The rule goes into the agreement they sign.
marketing.segMotoQ3: Can RoveHQ remind me about services?
marketing.segMotoA3: Yes. Set the next service by date, kilometers or both. A late service shows on your fleet list, and anything due within 7 days shows on your dashboard.
marketing.segMotoQ4: Can you bring in my existing records?
marketing.segMotoA4: Yes, free. Send a spreadsheet, photos of your booking book or your old software's export, and we'll bring in your bikes, customers, bookings and payments.
